P_0x0025A0: UA Shutedonias officer; former attache to Langran with wide connections.

U_0x0061E7:
One of the "Four Gods" <Chokijin> like RyuKoOh and KoRyuOh - semi-living weapons the ancients built to fight the demons called the "Hyakuja." It forms when JakuOhKi, the Suzaku <Chokijin>, combines with BuOhKi, the Genbu <Chokijin>.

U_0x00674D:

U_0x006CB2: A Four Gods <Chokijin> modeled on Genbu. High defense, low mobility; meant to shield other units, fights poorly alone.

U_0x014C8A:
Built by the Holy Kingdom of Langran in <La Gias>. Blessed by wind spirit Cyfis, called the "<Masoukishin> of the Wind." Its Fulcanelli perpetual engine needs the pilot's <Prana> (ki/aura) for peak output, so power depends on pilot aptitude.
Airtight frame allows underwater/space use; self-circulation system protects the pilot on long sorties. Aether, massless energy at rest in absolute coordinates, fuels its magic propulsion. Orichalconium armor, sealed with numerological wards at particle level, gives high magic defense.
Its Laplace Demon computer predicts events via causality, but this depends on the pilot's own magic. "Cybuster" is a ward-name against magic attack, not its true name.
U_0x0156CD: VThe Valsione, 2nd Valsion-series unit, enhanced with <La Gias> alchemy. ABMD drives its frame and DML traces the pilot's motions, giving flexible, human-like movement unmatched by other humanoid weapons.

U_0x019C37: Machine body of Perfectio, the "King of Ruin." It absorbs negative energy to doom the world; its arm faces are named "Despair" and "Fear."
U_0x000A69: Unit 1 of the R Series of <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-1." Built for close-quarters combat, it has high mobility and attack power. U_0x0014C2: Unit 3 of the R Series <Personal Trooper>s from the <SRX Project>, officially "REAL PERSONAL TROOPER TYPE-3 POWERED." U_0x001D49: A prototype all-purpose decisive-strike <Personal Trooper> of the <SRX Project>, formed from R-1, R-2 Powered, and R-3 Powered. Officially "SUPER ROBOT X-TYPE." U_0x0038CD:

Fitted with emergency "Patch Armor" and the anti-beam "Coating Cloak" mantle, it was thrown into combat. It also carries the <T-LINK System> (a telekinesis sensing amplifier), which reacted abnormally when Ing boarded; since then only he can pilot the Ashe.
U_0x003ED4: A bombardment AM part for the Huckebein Mk-III. A manned <Personal Trooper> carrier, also usable alone, mounting four G-Impact Cannons and missiles.

U_0x004CA5:
The Grungust is a special humanoid mobile weapon developed at the <Tesla Leicht Institute> from Grungust Type-0 and Gespenst Mk-II (Type S) data.
To perform in every domain, it transforms into a flight form (Winggust) and a heavy tank form (Gustlander). It runs on a plasma reactor, and its TGC joints cut load by controlling inertial mass via gravity control. Among the demanding Grungust series it has the best overall balance, earning the nickname "Super Fighter."

U_0x009718: Under Dr. Marion Radom's plan, Tasuku Shinguji upgraded the Guarlion Custom flown by his lover, Leona Garstein. Latest <Personal Trooper> tech and a <Tesla Drive> boost mobility/firepower, plus the <T-LINK System>. Like the Guarlion, shoulder inductors fix induction-heated metal particles ahead, wrapped and extended by a telekinetic field to strike foes.
U_0x009A12: An upgraded Giganscudo. TGC joints from the Grungust series are used at every joint, and the Sees Shield Units became Sees Anchor Units, improving melee ability. An improved Gravicon System lets it deploy a G-Territory, further raising defense. The Duro (Italian for 'hard') conversion plan was drawn up by Dr. Marion Radom; the unit is nicknamed 'Gandro.'
U_0x009CE6: An <Armored Module> for space flight/vacuum work, from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest Series 77 unit, based on the earlier Asterion AX. Twin flank <Tesla Drives> give unmatched mobility. Shifts between flight Cruise Figure (CF) and work Doll Figure (DF). Vs hostile deep-space life it mounts the gravity cannon 'G Accel Driver' and 'CTM' missiles.
U_0x00A05A: A high-mobility <Armored Module> from interstellar program <Project TD>. Newest of Series 77, based on the Calion. Two compact <Tesla Drives> give speed/agility beyond its sister, the Altairlion.
U_0x00A1F1: Combined form of Altairlion and Vegalion, newest <Project TD> Series 77 units. Its mobility and agility top every <Armored Module>, with immense firepower.
U_0x00A362:
An <Armored Module> built by the <Tesla Leicht Institute> with funding from the Principality of Riksent. Shine Hausen's personal unit.
Its Asterion test frame and <Tesla Drive> were reworked and miniaturized to lighten it to the limit, so its agility rivals the Asterion's. An <Energy Field> generator offsets its thin armor, and it mounts a special man-machine interface, the "W-LINK System".
The Type-G's cockpit is custom-built for the precognitive Shine, with the brainwave controls used in the Grungust and a high-grade G Canceller. The W-LINK System syncs the two Fairlions to correct the skill gap between Latooni and Shine; from the Type-S, Latooni can partly control the Type-G for coordinated attacks.
U_0x00A8B8:
An <Armored Module> built by the <Tesla Leicht Institute> with funding from the Principality of Riksent. Latooni Subota's personal unit.
Its Asterion test frame and <Tesla Drive> were reworked and miniaturized to lighten it to the limit, so its agility rivals the Asterion's. An <Energy Field> generator offsets its thin armor, and its "W-LINK System" interface syncs the two Fairlions to correct the skill gap between Latooni and Shine; from the Type-S, Latooni can partly control the Type-G for coordinated attacks.
U_0x00ACDE: A high-mobility <Armored Module> by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>, designed from <Project TD> Calion/Vegalion data. Rivals the Vegalion; flexible wing weapon operators wield <Armored Module> and <Personal Trooper> firearms. Also has an MTD missile bay and a folding TDA nose.
U_0x00AF3E: An <Armored Module> based on a prototype Galerion (the Guarlion's successor), customized for the <Boosted Children>. Though heavily armored, its <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX in mobility. The Present adds arm Tarnail Crushers and command functions.
U_0x00B141: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion prototype, customized for <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet <Tesla Drive> and thrusters outdo the Asterion AX.
U_0x00B2C3: An <Armored Module> based on a Galerion (Guarlion successor) prototype, tuned for the <Boosted Children>. Heavily armored, yet its <Tesla Drive> and back thrusters beat the Asterion AX in mobility. An EW model with EA (attack), EP (defense), ES (support) functions.
U_0x00B4DF: Lion's successor from <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; 'Relion' = 'Refined Lion.' Human-type arms wield varied weapons like the Guarlion. A multirole <Armored Module>: stronger, easier to handle, maintain, and build than the Lion.
U_0x00B6B8: A humanoid weapon of unknown origin, said to be a firm's new model in disguise.
U_0x00B780:
A mass-production <Armored Module> used by the <DC> and <Colony Integ. Army> in the <DC War>; it now serves both <DC> remnants and the <Earth Fed Army> (Federation code RAM-004V). An improved, more mobile Lion.
Its '<Tesla Drive>,' a thruster splitting gravitational from inertial mass, cancels gravitational mass only; small downward jets let it hover while small wings give lift. Thrust comes separately - a large engine in the distinctive lower hull, which doubles as landing gear. Attitude thrusters below allow terrain-following and ground combat; part swaps enable use in space. It is very simple and cheap for a <Tesla Drive> craft.
Production continues at <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>; it remains an <Earth Fed Army> mainstay.
U_0x00BCF9:
A variant of the <Armored Module> Lion. Officially 'Lion Type-L'; 'Landlion' is a nickname.
Built for ground combat, its four stick movers, fitted in place of legs, give high rough-terrain mobility; leveling them lowers its profile.
Less mobile and agile than the Lion, it mainly attacks and defends ground bases, so it mounts a large rail gun stronger than the normal type's. It can fly via <Tesla Drive>, but poorly suits air combat.
U_0x00C042:
&A mass-production <Armored Module> Lion variant used by <DC> remnants. Officially 'Lion Type-C'; 'Cosmolion' is a nickname.
Built for space combat: a large booster with improved <Tesla Drive> boosts speed/range; a missile container sits on its back. With tuning and skill it can work under gravity.
U_0x00C2BD: The top model of the Barrelion line, developed from the Barrelion Custom. It mounts two Big Head Railguns for greater firepower, with further reinforced armor and mobility. Though it looks like a large artillery piece, it can fly on its own via its <Tesla Drive>. Its armor is reinforced by a T-Dot Array, yielding a sturdy frame from minimal material and a simple, cheap, maintainable design.
U_0x00C5C6: A mass-produced <Armored Module> used by the <DC> and <Colony Integ. Army> in the <DC War>. <Isurugi Heavy Ind.> still produces it, and it serves both <DC> remnants and the <Earth Fed Army> (Federation type RAM-006). Built to fight humanoid weapons, it is a versatile high-performance unit tough enough for local battles too. Fielded as a commander's <Armored Module>, it is a fast battlefield-control unit that keeps pace with Lion formations. Its <Tesla Drive>, a reaction thruster separating gravitational and inertial mass, shapes the T-Dot Array into a repulsion field - the unit's 'shield.' LIEON-system limb control fixes the weapon shortage of the Lion and Barrelion, allowing melee blades and other arms. A cheaper variant omits the command functions.
U_0x00CB38: The mercenary Murata's machine, based on the Guarlion Custom. Large shoulder boosters raise its burst and charging power; with reinforced armor and the Shishioh Blade, it excels at sword combat.
U_0x00CC9B: A space-combat model of the mass-production Valsion (Valsion Kai). It swaps the pre-production type's flexible arms for booster units and reinforces the armor. Extra verniers tune it for space, but it fights under gravity too.
U_0x00CE4C: An update of <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>'s multirole fighter. Built for any theater, it fights at any altitude and hauls heavy payloads. Flexible special-material wings, a buried cockpit, and long-TBO modules set it apart.
U_0x00CFEE: <Earth Fed Army> tank w/ big railgun.
U_0x00D061: A space vessel used by <Earth Fed Army> and others. Its frame hull mounts weapon units (missiles, lasers), catapult containers for <Armored Module>s/<Personal Trooper>s, or cargo - serving as battleship, mothership, transport, or support ship.
U_0x00D259: A large space battleship used by <Earth Fed Army> and others, often a fleet flagship, with strong search and craft control. Made of a battle carrier bearing space fighters and <Armored Module>s, plus five beam-cannon ships, which can act alone or evacuate crew, used as missiles themselves.
U_0x00D478: A battle carrier used by <Shadow Mirror>. Its <Tesla Drive> gives great capacity/stealth; works in space, air, underwater. Rumored to counter Spacenoah carriers like Hagane.
U_0x00D634:
2nd Spacenoah-class all-purpose carrier, built vs. extraterrestrials. Floats via <Tesla Drive>, driven by 8 main rockets. Drag-resistant hull allows space, air, and underwater use. Strong anti-ship bombardment; carries <Personal Trooper>s and fighters, enabling "ISA" (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: mobile carrier + its humanoid weapons striking together).
Spacenoah class arose from two aims - escort ship for the Earth-evacuation fleet, and <PT> battle carrier vs. extraterrestrials - gaining combat power under the Earth Sphere Defense Concept despite the Evacuation Plan's aims. To hide this, it uses a modular design: hull/engines form a common core, with swappable combat modules at the bow. Ships 1-3 each carry a different module.
Hagane's bow module is the Tronium Buster Cannon, a high-output heavy-metal particle cannon giving top-class Federation firepower. Codename "Steel 2."
U_0x00DDA4: 3rd Spacenoah-class carrier, built vs. extraterrestrials. Floats via <Tesla Drive>, driven by 8 main rockets. Kurogane's bow module is a huge rotating ram for shattering bedrock (Excalibur Drill Ram), for anti-ship melee and clearing rock/ice. Raising <Tesla Drive> output forms the "Break Field," a ship-wide force field; with the ram, it breaks wide <Energy Field>s like those around enemy forts. Codename "Iron 3."
U_0x00E122: General-purpose battle carrier converted from the Hiryu. Humanity's first deep-space ship, it was the first fitted with a <Tesla Drive>. In NE 179, an <Aerogater> mobile weapon fleet attacked it beyond Pluto's orbit, damaging it; it limped back to Icarus Base in the asteroid belt. Later refitted per "ISA" doctrine (mobile battleship carrier + humanoid mobile weapons lightning assault), reborn as "Hiryu Kai." Its bow super-gravity impact cannon (from <EOT> tech) makes it second only to Hagane and Kurogane in power. Codename: "Dragon 2."
U_0x00E4FA: Flagship of the Gaia Sabers, built by <Isurugi Heavy Ind.>. Multiple <Tesla Drive>s let the all-purpose carrier operate in space, air, and on or under water. Faster than the Space Noah class and carrying more humanoid weapons, it stows bridge and guns for a high-speed cruise form. Its 'Break Field' (a T-Dot Array force field) and bow 'Field Blade' let it break lines, storm fortresses, and duel warships. Further special features remain unknown.
U_0x00E871: Aerial combat carrier used by <Earth Fed Army> and others. Fighters and <Armored Module>s launch and land in flight; its defenses and armament make it a flying fortress.
U_0x00E9BA: Large strategic transport plane of the <Earth Fed Army>. Carries up to five <Personal Trooper>s to the front; its launch catapult lets them sortie in flight for rapid deployment.
U_0x00EB56: First of the 'Dynamic General Guardian' ('Double G') series, humanoid weapons by Dr. Bian Zoldark, <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>) leader, to defend the <Earth Cradle>. A sword/melee unit; its 'DML System' and OS 'JINKI-1' unite pilot and machine. Its 'ABMD' artificial musculoskeletal drive gives far more supple, dynamic motion than same-size humanoid weapons.
U_0x00EE6C: Second 'Double G' of the 'Dynamic General Guardian' series designed by Bian Zoldark, leader of the <DC> (<Divine Crusaders>). To suit Ratsel's hit-and-run style it mounts a long-barreled beam cannon, high-output verniers, and wheels (Ferse Rad) for fast ground travel. It can shift to Pferd Mode and bear DyGenGuard on its back; the pair resemble a mounted warrior.
U_0x00F170: Third Dynamic General Guardian, built by Dr. Kaoru Tomine from Bian Zoldark's blueprints. A pilotless high-speed melee unit run by the AI 'System ZLAI,' made to destroy DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter. Ninja-themed, it wields shuriken (Multiply Blades) and a ninja sword (Anchor Secrate Sword). An improved 'ABMD (artificial musculoskeletal drive) System' makes it nimbler than both, with EA (electronic attack) and EP (electronic defense) functions.
U_0x00F4E2: A simplified mass-production Jinrai. Outwardly similar, it omits several features to cut costs, and its ABMD (artificial muscle drive) is fitted only in the legs. If the Jinrai is a chunin, this is a genin.
U_0x00F68F: A unit rebuilt from a captured Jinrai. The System ZLAI was removed, making it a manned machine with a DML (Direct Motion Link) system like DyGenGuard's. It also carries "System LIOH," a man-machine interface that learns a pilot's traits to draw out latent ability, doubling as control OS and troop-training system. Boosters made for DyGenGuard and Aussenseiter are fitted to its legs, and since pilot Touma excels at martial arts, it fights with kicks rather than the Jinrai's weapons.
U_0x00FA5A: The 7th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." An <S.Unit>-type machine that excels in close combat. Its Terminus Energy-based TE engine has many output-regulation problems, so its joints are partly battery-driven. To fine-tune output and assist control, a DFC (Direct Feeling Control) system is used, with a suited operator riding aboard. A second unit exists, but serves mainly as spare parts and goes unused.
U_0x00FDBB:
The 9th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project," consisting of a main body built from data on the 7th prototype Garmraid, plus the unmanned weapon "Machine Animalito." A new TE engine adds output and stability, and the "TE Sphere" energy field raises defense.
The Machine Animalito comprises the bird-type fighter "Hiou" and the wolf-type "Rouga." Each can operate alone, but they normally split into parts worn on Garmraid Blaze's arms, legs, shoulders and back.
With Rouga's head as a striking weapon on the right arm and Hiou as a wing booster on the back, it becomes "Form G," which, like Garmraid, excels in close combat.
U_0x01029E:
The 9th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project," consisting of a main body built from data on the 7th prototype Garmraid, plus the unmanned weapon "Machine Animalito." A new TE engine adds output and stability, and the "TE Sphere" energy field raises defense.
The Machine Animalito comprises the bird-type fighter "Hiou" and the wolf-type "Rouga." Each can operate alone, but they normally split into parts worn on Garmraid Blaze's arms, legs, shoulders and back.
With Rouga's head as a shield on the left arm and Hiou as a back-mounted cannon, it becomes "Form S," excelling at mid- and long-range combat. Shield plus TE Sphere also make it slightly tougher than Form G.
U_0x0107C4: The 6th prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." Highly mobile, it excels at mid- and long-range combat. Its Terminus Energy-based TE engine has many output-regulation problems, so its joints are partly battery-driven. To fine-tune output and assist control, a DFC (Direct Feeling Control) system is used, with a suited operator riding aboard. A second unit exists, but serves mainly as spare parts and goes unused.
U_0x010B1E:
IThe eighth prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." It pairs a main body built on data from Cerberus with an add-on armament unit, the "Ignite Parts." A new TE Engine gives it more output and stability than Cerberus, and an energy field called the "TE Sphere" boosts its defense.
The Ignite Parts can fly alone as an unmanned fighter but are normally mounted on the Cerberus Ignite itself. The body also transforms between the melee form "Figure W" and the bombardment form "Figure B" (front and back reverse), giving it high versatility. Figure W with the Ignite Parts attached, called "Form G," excels at close combat.
U_0x010FDC:
IThe eighth prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." It pairs a main body built on data from Cerberus with an add-on armament unit, the "Ignite Parts." A new TE Engine gives it more output and stability than Cerberus, and an energy field called the "TE Sphere" boosts its defense.
The Ignite Parts can fly alone as an unmanned fighter but are normally mounted on the Cerberus Ignite itself. The body also transforms between the melee form "Figure W" and the bombardment form "Figure B" (front and back reverse), giving it high versatility. Figure B with the Ignite Parts attached, called "Form S," excels at bombardment.
U_0x011496:
MThe fifth prototype TE Absorber of the "Tsentr Project." Dr. Mitarl Zapad, its central figure, created the "TE Engine," an application of "Terminus Energy," and the self-repairing armor material "Razmnanium." Both proved hard to control; after trial and error on prototypes 1-4, Mitarl shelved a machine carrying both. Razmnanium went to prototype 5, Medius Locus, and the TE Engine to prototypes 6 and 7, Cerberus and Garmraid, each pursuing its own function.
Medius Locus was built on <Personal Trooper> data; though its output trails the TE Engine units, it boasts high mobility and responsiveness.
U_0x01194A: The transformed Medius Locus. Using the data AI1 gathered, it changed form via Razmnanium's self-evolution, gaining vast power. Now far larger, its shape and arms resemble an <S.Unit>'s - likely because Erde, wary of the tenth TE Absorber prototype, pushed AI1 to grow to rival it.
U_0x011BA1: The tenth and effectively final prototype TE Absorber. "Galvus" merges "Garmraid" and "Cerberus (Kerberos)"; another name is "MODEL-X." Carrying all the project's fruits - the TE Engine, Razmnanium and AI1 - it is in theory maintenance-free and runs semi-permanently. Blending Cerberus Ignite and Garmraid Blaze, it takes forms resembling each: "Form G" (Garmraid) excels at melee, "Form C" (Cerberus) at gunnery. Fully AI1-controlled, it fulfills missions without fail, unswayed by emotion and working where humans cannot.
U_0x011FC1:
A humanoid mobile weapon of the Gaia Sabers' Alpha Saber, built from data on the captured "Lestgemira" (Earth codename: Geminira), an unmanned variable weapon of the <Inspectors>. Keeping its flexible frame and wide joints, the Canis is highly mobile and responsive and mounts a high-performance <Tesla Drive>; its transform gear was cut for cost.
The short gap from its appearance to mass production leaves its origins murky.
U_0x01230C: A humanoid mobile weapon of the Gaia Sabers' Alpha Saber squad, built from the captured "Lestgemira" (EN codename: Geminira), an unmanned variable mobile weapon of the <Inspectors>. Its flexible frame and wide-range joints give high mobility; transformation was omitted to cut costs. The Altarf adds large command wings with a high-performance <Tesla Drive>; its Double Gunnery (live rounds + beams) is a long-barrel version with a large bayonet.
U_0x0126A1: 6A state where Crossgate energy drove the Razumnanium berserk; the core housing AI1 swelled and fused with the TE Engine. As "ALL In 1" implies, it absorbs everything.
U_0x01280D: A super robot piloted by Kouta Azuma, alias Fighter Roar. His grandfather Kisaburo rebuilt it from a humanoid mobile weapon entrusted to him by Roar, a warrior from another world. Its OG (Over Gate) Engine, a product of otherworldly technology, opens a limited dimensional rift and powers the machine with particles from an adjacent subspace. As the engine is not fully repaired, its true power remains sealed. ABMD- and DML-like systems let it move as one with its pilot. Also called the "Compati Kaiser" or "Battle Force Robo."
U_0x012C50:
The combined form of the Compatible Kaiser and the large fighter G Thundergate. Its OG (Over Gate) Engines, products of otherworldly technology, open a limited dimensional rift and power the machine with special particles from an adjacent subspace, while ABMD- and DML-like systems let it move as one with its pilot.
With the G Thundergate transformed into a large wing booster on the Kaiser's back, mobility and speed improve and weapons such as the Shoulder Cannon are added. Linking both machines' OG Engines amplifies output, enabling the ultimate weapon, the Over Kaiser Sword. Commonly called the "G Compati Kaiser."
U_0x01313C: A large fighter that supports the Compatible Kaiser. Like the Kaiser it mounts an OG (Over Gate) Engine, giving it high mobility and firepower. Only Emi Armor wearers can pilot it. Thought lost in a past battle with Dark Brain, it was recovered with the Emi Armor and repaired as an anti-Kaiser weapon. Once black, it regained its original red when combined.
U_0x013404: Kouta Azuma clad in the Roar Armor. The crystal on its brow houses Roar's soul. The airtight suit works in space or underwater (the hair radiates heat; flesh-toned armor covers the nose and mouth, a thin clear shield the eyes), and its hardpoints take option parts. The armor vastly boosts Kouta's physique; with back thrusters and the Fighter Beam Gun he can even fight humanoid mobile weapons.
U_0x013705:
A super robot Dr. Kisaburo Azuma built on commission from a certain company, before he met Compatible Kaiser. Officially "Bankaran," it became "G Bankaran" when Michiru Hanaten added the "G."
A melee-focused power fighter, its heavy armor and rugged frame make it durable, and joints refined with Compatible Kaiser know-how let the heavyweight move nimbly. Its look mirrors a young Kisaburo, who meant to pilot it himself if needed.
U_0x013A76:
A special humanoid mobile weapon for sword combat. Its Direct Feedback System sends the pilot's thoughts straight to the machine, and it wields slashing arms like the "Five Great Blades." The mantle is a shield that can even deflect beams.
Likely developed alongside Soulgain, it shares parts but lacks the pilot-uniting Direct Action Link System. Its response trails Soulgain's, yet stronger thrusters give it a higher top speed.
U_0x013DB3:
A special close-combat humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Axel Almer. Its Direct Action Link System syncs the machine to the pilot's movements; with the Direct Feedback System and ABMD (artificial skeletal-muscle drive), it gains superb response and mobility. Liquid-metal blades in both elbows work with its fists for strong melee power.
Most of its armor is EG alloy, a shape-recovering active metal, so it partly self-repairs battle damage.
U_0x014101:
A humanoid assault weapon of the "Assault Dragoon" category. It records the pilot's brainwave patterns, then semi-forcibly syncs via machine feedback, turning reflexes directly into commands for patterned operations.
Remote flying gun turrets called Sword Breakers mount on both shoulders, favoring mid-long range. A commander's unit; several sister units exist.
U_0x0143D2:
A special humanoid mobile weapon piloted by Lamia Loveless. Near-organic wings and feminine armor lend it a mystical air. Its arms - energy shaped into lances or arrows, plus a slim rapier - evoke a Western knight, yet its materials and power source are unknown; it likely uses <EOT>.
<Isurugi Heavy Ind.> reputedly built it for the Federation's next mainline unit trials, though unproven. Its registry bars all but its set pilot, Lamia.
U_0x0146F7:
Humanoid mobile weapon for ground bombardment. Also called Type 34. This custom unit grafts its successor's drivetrain and generator into the mass-produced RGV-Type 30 "Randgriz" to boost firepower and armor, with heavy plating, a shield, jammer, and beam coating.
The Razangriff Raven adds a flight unit/armed base with a <Tesla Drive> and plasma generator, letting it fly under gravity, plus a focused charged-particle cannon.
U_0x01526F: zCybuster's cruising form, modeled on Dishnas, divine bird of Langran.
U_0x015327: Second of the Valsion series, built by <DC> leader Bian Zoldark for his daughter Lune. Artificial muscles give flexible, human-like movement (even facial expressions) beyond any <Personal Trooper> or <Armored Module>. A compact improved <Tesla Drive> allows independent flight. Armed with the wide-area Psycho Blaster plus the Valsion's Cross Smasher and Divine Arm, its combat power is very high. The DML system lets pilot and machine move as one.
U_0x015C5E: A <Masoukishin> guarded by water spirit Gadd. Versatile, but weak offense. Wields the spear Gungnir, treated with special alloy that boosts magic amplification, channeling great power into magic weapons.
U_0x015E12: A <Masoukishin> guarded by fire spirit Granba. High offense, weak defense. Controls caloric overactivated by Granba via the "Caloric Recycler," an engine that also converts excess caloric to drive energy, aiding Granveil's high output.
U_0x016034: A <Masoukishin> guarded by earth spirit Samouji. Slower than others, but high defense plus self-regeneration. Left-arm vibrator locks an enemy's drive systems on hit, or triggers earthquakes via resonance when driven into ground. Bay holds three Familiars.
U_0x01625C: Saphine's own unit, designed by her. Same concept as an <Elemental>, but she calls it a "Fae Unit." Drawing <Elemental>-level power sans spirit contract is a unique Volkruss technique. Still experimental; output unstable.
U_0x0163FD: An <Elemental> based on Solgady, similar performance. Second most-built, after Browel. Spirit: split soul of wind spirit Soleid.
U_0x016512: An <Elemental> contracted with thunder spirit Garnansa. Last finished in the Project, near <Masoukishin> level, but never gained self-awareness. Four arms shine in melee, though only a master can use them fully, since control syncs to body sense. Resembles Granveil (same designer), but design is closer to Cybuster.
U_0x0167BA: Langran's first true <Elemental>, guarded by Janok, spirit of the heat haze. Its high-output <Prana> converter can rival a <Masoukishin>. Early reinforced-ceramic armor leaves it fragile, but its motion control became the basis for later <Elemental>s. Rare among them, it carries a handheld gun.
U_0x016A37: An <Elemental> bound to the forest spirit Dianos. Built for mid-range fire support with twin linear rail guns on both shoulders, its nimble balance also lets skilled pilots fight up close. Its design later spawned a mass-produced <Elemental> based on the Diablo.
U_0x016C50: Prototype 1 of the <Elemental> project. Three were built to test spirit contracts; one broke under the pact. Two awaited scrapping until Feil-Lord renewed the pacts; Xenia and Monica got them as ceremonial <Elemental>s, weakly armed but fitted with repair gear.
U_0x016E47: A Norse remodeled by Xenia and Monica for more combat power. Base specs are similar, but weapons were upgraded, mainly boosting rear support and repair. 'Ray' is Langran for 'revised'.
U_0x016FB8: An <Elemental> used by the Shutedonias army. Built as an all-rounder, it performs capably in every role but lacks a decisive edge.
U_0x0170AC: A Shutedonias army <Elemental>, a simplified mass-produced Gildora. Improved <Prana> converter, but spirit limits keep it low-rank.
U_0x01759E: A B-class <Elemental> of the Shutedonias army. Planned as a C-class, it proved so well balanced in tuning that it was rated B-class.
U_0x0176F1: Ort's personal unit, modified with no expense spared for a massive power boost.
U_0x017793: A D-class <Elemental>. Built for construction and hardly worthy of the name, it was hastily armed amid rising international tensions and so dubbed an <Elemental>.
U_0x0178D3: A mobile fortress used across <La Gias>, armed with AA guns and barion beam cannons. Carries multiple <Elemental>s.
U_0x0179AD: In truth one of Volkruss's avatars. Much weaker, but matches an A-class <Elemental>.
U_0x017A58: Volkruss with both halves united. Not the avatar seen in <La Gias>, but another being copying its form and power.
U_0x017B39: Kirkus's super <Elemental>, built from <Masoukishin> Granveil and Zamzeed data. Made in secret after the plan was axed, it outclasses even the <Masoukishin>.
U_0x017C96: An unmanned robot that guards temples. Its combat power is low.
U_0x017D11: A versatile unmanned recon drone flying via ionocraft; <La Gias> nations armed it.
U_0x017DCF: An <Elemental> of the Shutedonias army. As Shutedonias lags in alchemy, it was built to compensate with its own science. High output and firepower.
U_0x017EEB: A giant mud doll built around evil and vengeful spirits, summoned by Louzorl's necromancy.
U_0x017FA7: The cursed-spirit machine Louzorl pilots. Half exists in the astral plane, so it is ghostlike and immune to normal weapons.
U_0x01808D: A Shutedonias army <Elemental>. Built for support, it excels in melee and anti-air combat.
U_0x01814A: A Shutedonias <Elemental>. It cannot contract with spirits, relying on converter power.
U_0x0181F8: An unmanned <Inspectors> weapon. High-grade sensors suit armed recon and patrol. Earth codename: 'Urchin.'
U_0x0182C7: A Guest mass-produced artillery unit mounting a large Driver Cannon. Unsuited to melee.
U_0x01837C: A mass-produced Guest unit built for firepower, with many high-output verniers for assault.
